scope: synthetic Cylinder development; real Cylinder unavailable
replay_policy: 50% Cylinder ClimbWall view sampling, 25% original dual pair, 25% original single Sample10 pairs
normalization: fixed original pair baseline per scene, unchanged across subsets
budget_policy: identical scenes, V counts, image shapes and seed per optimizer slot; only Cylinder camera selection changes
checkpoint_policy: fixed final step; no validation checkpoint selection or automatic promotion
